create_to_parquet: create a parquet file from a pandas DataFrame with pyarrow engine and snappy compression
read_parquet_file: read a parquet file from disk or URL and return a pandas DataFrame
read_parquet_with_filters: read a parquet file with column selection and row-level filters using pyarrow engine
write_parquet_partitioned: write a DataFrame to partitioned parquet files using partition_cols on a directory path
read_parquet_nullable_dtypes: read a parquet file and convert columns to nullable numpy or pyarrow-backed dtypes
